title: The Checkout Container Keeps Disappearing
symptom: Checkout is down. The on-call developer says the 'web' container 'just disappears' a few minutes after starting. They restarted it once; it vanished again. Find out why before anyone restarts it a third time.

evidence.description: what it was doing when it died

question.prompt: Why does the web container keep disappearing?
options: A code bug crashes it with a normal error
It exceeds its memory limit and is OOM-killed (exit 137) while loading the product catalog
Its healthcheck fails, so Docker stops it

debrief: 'docker ps' hid it because it had exited — 'docker ps -a' showed Exited (137), and 137 = 128 + 9 means SIGKILL. 'docker inspect --format {{.State.OOMKilled}}' confirmed the kernel killed it for exceeding its memory limit, and the last log line showed why: loading a 2.1GB catalog into a container with a much smaller limit. Restarting it a third time would have failed identically. Fix the design (stream or paginate the catalog) or raise the limit with real headroom — and note Docker healthchecks never stop containers on their own; that's an orchestrator's job.
